entities.summary: Aurelian, a notable figure in the history of Romania, associated with Dacians & Roman Dacia (106–271). Preceded by Roman Dacia & Romanisation and Trajan's Dacian Wars (101–106 CE) — conquest and provincialization. Their legacy influenced Second Bulgarian Empire.
